description: GitHub template for task-specific agent memory that learns from human corrections: slim facts, three feedback subagents, deterministic pytest checks and a footprint commit per request. No API key, no database, no service.
rules: Start a task repo with `gh repo create <name> --template cerredz/vidbyte-memory --private --clone`, then replace the `## Task` block in AGENTS.md.
Read AGENTS.md on every request; it is an index, so open only the memory files whose 'load when' matches the request.
Log human feedback verbatim in memory/feedback-log.md before launching the fact, test and update subagents.
Never edit facts/, memory/rules.md, memory/guarantees.md or tests/ as a side effect of generation; they change only through skills/handle-feedback.
Never rewrite a memory file whole: append entries and edit metadata lines in place; supersede or retire, never delete.
Give every generative step 3 to 5 verification rounds: python -m pytest -q tests plus the verifiers in verifiers/INDEX.md.
End every request with: python scripts/footprint.py --write, python -m pytest -q tests, python scripts/footprint.py --commit --title "<request>".
Memory is context, not enforcement: when a rule keeps being missed, add a test or a verifier instead of stronger wording.
